tools.name: encbird_get_context
tools.description: Read stored learning level without private profile fields.

tools.name: encbird_list_expressions
tools.description: List saved expressions; coverage and clipping are explicit.

tools.name: encbird_add_expression
tools.description: Request expression registration; obtain explicit payment approval if returned.

tools.name: encbird_search_expressions
tools.description: Search saved phrases and Korean meanings.

tools.name: encbird_list_review_quizzes
tools.description: List selected questions and phrase associations; listing is not completion.

tools.name: encbird_submit_quiz_result
tools.description: Save actual answer, learner rating 1-4 and assistance for a pinned question revision.

tools.name: encbird_save_memory
tools.description: Save permitted host messages and evidence-grounded learning facts.

observedAt.description: Actual observation timestamp; at most five minutes in the future.

occurredOn.description: Optional source-grounded date; future dates require kind plan.

items.description: Evidence quotes must exactly occur in distinct cited role=user source messages. Learning facts require four actual user messages and two independent evidence messages.

tools.name: encbird_correct_memory
tools.description: Correct a versioned external learning fact with new user evidence.

observedAt.description: Actual observation timestamp; at most five minutes in the future.

occurredOn.description: Optional source-grounded date; future dates require kind plan.

fact.description: Evidence quotes must exactly occur in distinct cited role=user source messages. Learning facts require four actual user messages and two independent evidence messages.

tools.name: encbird_delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a versioned external learning fact and invalidate dependent recommendations.

tools.name: encbird_list_suggested_expressions
tools.description: Read current internal and external suggested expressions.

phraseOrigin.description: Recorded expression origin. Omitted for legacy rows; absence does not establish learner usage.

tools.name: encbird_save_suggested_expressions
tools.description: Save expression candidates with explicit actual-user, quoted, or host-generated origin and referenced learner evidence.

observedAt.description: Actual observation timestamp; at most five minutes in the future.

phraseOrigin.description: user_expression: expression actually used by the learner; quoted_expression: expression quoted in an actual learner message; host_generated: host-created wording based on learner intent. The first two must occur in a referenced role=user message.

tools.name: encbird_save_freechat_scenarios
tools.description: Save evidenced host-generated scenario candidates without starting a chat.

observedAt.description: Actual observation timestamp; at most five minutes in the future.

tools.name: encbird_accept_suggested_expression
tools.description: Acknowledge an already registered NORMAL expression and close its version-pinned recommendation without charging.

version.description: Exact selected candidate version. Explicit zero is allowed for an unchanged legacy candidate.

registrationKey.description: Exact key from the successful registration attempt (its original idempotencyKey); 1–128 printable ASCII bytes 0x21–0x7e, with no whitespace. Current AddExpressionResult does not echo the key.
